featured_reviews.name: Tejaswini Bhosle
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had seen a lot of good things and reviews about this place on reels, so visited with high expectations.
The food was fine, but not something I would specially revisit for.
It was decent, but didn’t really stand out to me.
The solkadi was above average (3/5), while the bombil fry, kolambi fry, surmai thali, and modak were average overall (2.5/5).
The taste was simple, which some people may enjoy, but I personally felt the place is slightly overhyped for the price point.
The quantity also felt less compared to the pricing.
A few accompaniments usually served with fish fry, like green chutney, were unavailable too. Overall, not a bad experience, but slightly overrated in my opinion.
Personally, I still prefer home-cooked seafood over this.

featured_reviews.name: Dhananjay Naik
featured_reviews.review_text:
⭐ Rating: 1/5

I visited this restaurant to celebrate my birthday, and unfortunately, it turned into one of the worst dining experiences I’ve ever had.

Food

The food was mostly average. However, the chicken breast I ordered was extremely chewy and not tender at all. Other dishes were just okay.

Ambience

The ambience is the only good thing about this place.

Service — Absolutely Terrible

The service completely ruined my special day.
•	We had given our cake to be kept in the fridge in advance.
•	When we were seated, we were not even offered water.
•	While placing our appetizer order, we clearly requested that the cake be cut before the appetizers arrived — this was completely ignored.
•	Appetizers arrived first, still no water was served.
•	When we finally received the water bottle, no glasses were provided.
•	After repeated requests, only 4 glasses were given for a table of 7 people. We again had to ask for the remaining 3 glasses.
•	Even after raising this with the manager, the response was extremely slow and careless.
•	For a table of 7 people, we were asked to “adjust” with extra chairs and tables instead of being properly seated.

Towards the end, we requested a straw for a drink. The lady waiter kept roaming around empty tables, and we again had to call her and remind her about our request.

It was very evident that the staff was completely unfocused and poorly trained.

Food can be average and still acceptable — but service is what makes a restaurant good, and sadly this restaurant failed completely in that aspect.

Spend 6k for worst experience I have ever had. Never visiting here again.
Not recommended at all if you value basic hospitality and decent service.

featured_reviews.name: Jay Shetty
featured_reviews.review_text:
My friend and I visited around 12:00 PM when the restaurant was completely empty, hoping for a pleasant lunch. Unfortunately, the experience was disappointing from start to finish.
​The Service: Despite being the only customers, it took 30 minutes just to receive our drinks (Spicy Lady). By the time we finished our appetizers, it was already 1:40 PM. Because of this excessive delay, we decided to skip the main course entirely.
​The Food:
​Multani Mushroom: This was the only saving grace; it was quite good.
​Chicken Wonton: As a professional chef, I immediately recognized that these were frozen and not defrosted properly before cooking. The filling was still cold in the center.
​Dessert (Pull-up Rasmalai Tres Leches): This was the most shocking part of our meal. We found mold/rot in the center of the cake, which is a severe health hazard.
​The Management: When we pointed out these issues—especially the moldy dessert—the staff offered no apology. Instead, they seemed eager to drop the bill and have us leave to avoid dealing with the situation. We expected basic accountability and food safety, but received neither. I cannot recommend this place.

featured_reviews.name: Jason Bharakhada
featured_reviews.review_text:
- I recently had the opportunity to dine at Zeal 2, a trendy establishment known for its captivating atmosphere. Walking into the restaurant, I was immediately captivated by the stylish decor and well-thought-out interior design. The lighting was warm and inviting, creating a cozy and intimate atmosphere. The modern furnishings added a touch of elegance, making it an ideal setting for a special night out or a gathering with friends.

- Unfortunately, despite the promising ambiance, the food at restaurant did not quite live up to the expectations set by the setting. While the menu offered an interesting selection of dishes, the execution fell short in some areas.

- For starters we ordered KEBABS and they were really good. The meat was cooked to perfection, tender and juicy, with the flavors infused deep within. They were Like finger licking good!!!

- For main course, ordered BUTTER CHICKEN with ROTI and it really lacked spices.  It was not terrible but it lacked the depth and refinement that one would expect from a restaurant of this caliber.
Later ordered BIRYANI which had a blend of aromatic spices and seasonings infused in every bite creating a symphony of flavours.

Overall, the place excels in creating a captivating ambiance and delivering attentive service. The restaurant's stylish decor and cozy atmosphere make it a great place to unwind and enjoy a pleasant evening.
